newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ridley increases Joe White offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ridley increases Joe White offer.

text.p: Ridley Corp Ltd said on Friday it would increase its bid for Joe White Maltings Ltd by 14 cents per share to an effective A$5.44 per share by allowing shareholders to retain the recently declared fully franked dividend of the same amount.
Ridley also said its bid for the malting company had been extended by two weeks and would now close on October 24.

"The effective increase in Ridley's offer represents a premium of 41 percent to the price of A$3.85 at which Ridley began its acquisition of shares in Joe White in April of this year and a preimum of 39 percent to Joe White's net tangible assets," Ridley said.

Joe White directors said on September 19 that an independent report had found that the A$5.30 per share bid was neither fair nor reasonable. The bid was increased from A$4.85 on September 6. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
